correctness.rationale: The self-transverse double-point formula gives [Z]^2=c2(X)+2=14. Pullback by the degree-nine isogeny gives square 126. The integral divisor lattice on A×A has top intersections 144, -144 and 864 (all other degree-four basis monomials vanish), so every integral divisor-product square is divisible by 144. The contradiction is exact.
